name: Landbright · Joiners and movers from HiBob
description: On HiBob's employee.created, employee.joined and employee.updated: read the employee from HiBob and create or update them in Landbright, keyed by their HiBob id. Before their start date they are a pre-hire (no sign-in, no invite); on it they become active and get their invite. A mover's new department, title, manager or site is updated, and the Onboard flow moves their birthright groups. A last day (termination date) is kept: Landbright deactivates them when it ends. Needs the hris and landbright plugins.
